Are you looking to win big? The West Virginia Lottery offers a variety of games if you think it’s your lucky day.

Lotto America: 10:15 p.m. ET on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. Daily 3, 4: 6:59 p.m. ET Monday through Saturday. Cash 25: 6:59 p.m. ET Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday.
